hero.title:
Service. Education.
Harmony.
hero.text: Community centres where families meet today's needs with dignity — and build the skills, relationships and confidence for lasting change.

programs.title: Nutrition & Ration
programs.text: Daily cooked meals and household ration support, designed around dignity: simple enrolment, scheduled collection instead of queues, home delivery for those who cannot travel, and a community of volunteers behind every basket.

programs.title: Medical
programs.text: Specialist medical camps, mother and child health services, outpatient care and telemedicine for families in rural and semi-urban India — with structured follow-up so that a first consultation becomes lasting care.

programs.title: Education
programs.text: A community library, child-centred English classes, creative workshops, vocational training for women and computer literacy — safe, joyful learning spaces where children and adults build language, skills and confidence.

programs.title: Grants & Livelihoods
programs.text: Needs-assessed grants and interest-free loans for medical costs, school fees and household essentials, backed by dedicated case workers who stay with each family on the path from crisis to stability to self-reliance.

programs.title: Wellness
programs.text: Our wellness programmes help people build healthier habits through education, movement, nutrition and reflection. AMAN, our flagship cohort programme, is joined by art circles, Hapkido self-defence classes and a community art space.

programs.title: Community Outreach
programs.text: Trust comes before services. Through monthly neighbourhood visits built around art and listening, home visits, counsellor-led family follow-up and trained volunteers, we build the long-term relationships that connect families to lasting support.

programs.title: Humrahe Khair
programs.text: Humrahe Khair, meaning Together for Good, brings communities together through dialogue gatherings, collaborative service projects and shared resource mapping, turning conversation into practical cooperation across organisations in India and the USA.

feature.title: Community Outreach
feature.text: Outreach is the connective tissue of our work: basti visits, counsellors and trained volunteers who build trust street by street, understand what each family actually needs, and link them to sustained support across our programs.

cta.title: Make a Difference Today
cta.text: Whether through a donation, volunteering your time, or applying for support — every action creates ripples of positive change.

sections.storiesSubtitle: Real stories of lives changed through compassion and service.

why.heading: Intergenerational poverty is not solved by isolated acts of charity. It takes long-term, relationship-centred work.
why.intro: Intergenerational poverty is rarely broken by a single act of help. Families facing hunger, educational inequity, poor health access and fragile livelihoods need more than isolated interventions — they need trusted local places that combine support, participation and continuity over the long term. We believe in dignity and participation over transactional charity: meeting today's needs in ways that build tomorrow's capability.

differentiators.heading: A hub, not a distribution point
differentiators.text: Each centre is a welcoming local space where people access services, build relationships and gain skills — shaped by its own neighbourhood, and part of a network that shares one mission of dignity and capability.

differentiators.heading: Connected support, not isolated projects
differentiators.text: Food, education, health, wellbeing and livelihood programmes are designed to reinforce one another. Someone who first comes for food support might join a skills class; a child in tuition might move into computer literacy — every doorway leads to another.

differentiators.heading: Relationships as infrastructure
differentiators.text: Counsellors, outreach workers and volunteers are not peripheral extras — they are the human system through which trust and continuity are built, so that help arrives as a sustained relationship rather than a one-off transaction.

differentiators.heading: From recipient to contributor
differentiators.text: The aim is not dependence but growth. People who arrive needing support are helped to become participants, then contributors — volunteers, mentors and local leaders who carry the work forward in their own communities.
